permissionRoles.name: User Manager
permissionRoles.description: Can view, create, update and unlock users in the realm.

permissionRoles.name: OAuth Admin
permissionRoles.description: Full CRUD over OAuth clients, scopes and APIs.

permissionRoles.name: Read-only Viewer
permissionRoles.description: Can only read user and role lists — no mutations.

permissionRoles.name: Group Admin
permissionRoles.description: Manages AuthorizationGroups: members, roles and access scripts.

authorizationGroups.name: User Managers
authorizationGroups.description: Staff who create and manage users inside the realm. Demonstrates classic MANUAL membership: explicit member list, role grants flow through the group.

authorizationGroups.name: OAuth Administrators
authorizationGroups.description: Responsible for OAuth clients, scopes and APIs. Also manual membership.

authorizationGroups.name: Demo Domain Users (auto)
authorizationGroups.description: AUTO-MEMBERSHIP showcase: every Person whose email ends with @demo.local is a member automatically. Try creating a new user with a matching email and watch the member list grow.

authorizationGroups.name: Group Admins
authorizationGroups.description: Holds the Group Admin role. Clara manages authorization groups without touching users or OAuth.

authorizationGroups.name: All Staff (nested)
authorizationGroups.description: NESTED GROUP showcase: this group has no direct person members — its members are other groups. Permissions flow transitively: anyone in User Managers, OAuth Administrators or Group Admins inherits everything this group grants.
